notes: House of Refuge / City Work House grounds; the dashed 'Drive' lines are private drives and are not recorded. SASSAFRAS and COMFORT are printed without suffix and written with 'Street'. Comfort only shows as a short stub from the 'See Volume Six' area and ends at Sassafras. Colerain Av runs down the left margin with only its east line drawn; at the top its centre (~x 70) falls in the binding gutter, so Colerain/Sassafras is not recorded here (it is on sheet 293); at the bottom the centre is on the paper and Colerain/Bates Alley is recorded from the east line. Bates Alley (10 ft) runs along the bottom from Colerain to the right margin (x~6280, continues on sheet 295). An unnamed ~10 ft alley (no width printed) leaves Bates Alley's south side at x~950 and runs SSE off the bottom edge (sheet 287); Henshaw Av likewise runs off the bottom edge.
